verdict.rationale: Event webhooks are a fair question for a government tax service with online portals and open-data feeds, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only authenticated Webfile/eSystems portals, EDI filing, and a keyless read-only Socrata open-data query. Nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event subscription mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
